definitions.explanation: Refers to any thing without restriction; whatever one wants.

definitions.gloss: I hear that; they say that
definitions.explanation: Used to introduce hearsay or reported information.

definitions.gloss: by all means; at any cost
definitions.explanation: Expresses determination or strong desire to achieve something.

examples.japanese: {困|こま}ったことがあれば{何|なん}でも{聞|き}いてね。
examples.english: If you have any problems, ask me anything.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}の{兄|あに}は{本|ほん}が{好|す}きで、{何|なん}でも{読|よ}む。{歴史|れきし}も{小説|しょうせつ}も{読|よ}む。
examples.english: My brother likes books and reads anything. He reads history and novels.
I hear it's going to rain.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}でも、{彼|かれ}は{転職|てんしょく}するらしい。
{何|なん}でも、{来月|らいげつ}{新|あたら}しい{店|みせ}ができるそうだ。
examples.english: I hear a new store is opening next month.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}でも、{先生|せんせい}は{来週|らいしゅう}{休|やす}みだって。
examples.english: I hear the teacher is off next week.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}でも、あの{二人|ふたり}は{高校|こうこう}の{時|とき}から{友達|ともだち}らしい。{今|いま}も{仲|なか}がいいそうだ。
examples.english: I hear those two have been friends since high school. Apparently they're still close now.
I want to win by any means.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}でも{手|て}に{入|い}れたい。
examples.english: I want to get it at any cost.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}でも{成功|せいこう}したい。
examples.english: I want to succeed by all means.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}でもあの{会社|かいしゃ}に{入|はい}りたい。
examples.english: I want to join that company by any means.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{何|なん}でもあのチームに{入|はい}りたいと{言|い}っていた。{本当|ほんとう}に{努力|どりょく}したそうだ。
examples.english: He said he wanted to join that team by any means. Apparently he really worked hard.

notes:
{何|なん}でも has several distinct uses.

ANYTHING/EVERYTHING:
- {何|なん}でも{食|た}べる (eat anything)
- {何|なん}でもいい (anything is fine)
- {何|なん}でも{知|し}っている (know everything)

HEARSAY (sentence-initial):
- {何|なん}でも〜らしい/そうだ (I hear that ~)
- Common way to introduce rumors or secondhand information

BY ALL MEANS:
- {何|なん}でも{手|て}に{入|い}れたい (want to get it by any means)
- Less common usage

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {何|なに}も (nothing - with negative)
- {何|なに}か (something)
- {誰|だれ}でも (anyone)
- {何|いつ}でも (anytime)
- {何処|どこ}でも (anywhere)
